description: Import and Export Control Department - Import and Export Control Act No 1 of 1969
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act, specifically amending import control requirements for wheat flour. It contains legal/regulatory provisions including amendments to existing regulations, import control licensing requirements, and operational instructions for relevant authorities. The content focuses on establishing a legal framework for import controls rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
